# Meta Marketing API (ads) connector

Go connector for the Meta Marketing API: managing Facebook AND Instagram ads through one surface — ad accounts, campaigns, ad sets, ads, creatives, and insights. Generated from a curated OpenAPI spec authored from the official Meta documentation (Meta publishes no OpenAPI spec).

## How to use this connector

One `Client` serves one access token (user or system user) with the
`ads_management` permission (`ads_read` suffices for read-only). Instagram
ads are NOT a separate API: they are placements inside the same ad
account, controlled by `Targeting`/placement fields and the creative's
Instagram identity.

```go
import (
    "github.com/pax-beehive/connector"
    "github.com/pax-beehive/connector/metaads"
)

c, err := metaads.NewClient(&metaads.Config{AccessToken: "EAAG..."})

// The object hierarchy is Campaign -> Ad Set -> Ad (with a Creative).
camp, err := c.CreateCampaign(ctx, &metaads.CreateCampaignRequest{
    AdAccountId:         "act_123",            // always act_-prefixed
    Name:                connector.Ptr("spring sale"),
    Objective:           connector.Ptr("OUTCOME_TRAFFIC"),
    Status:              connector.Ptr("PAUSED"),
    SpecialAdCategories: connector.Ptr("[]"),  // required, JSON array string
    DailyBudget:         connector.Ptr(int64(1000)), // minor units (cents)
})
```

Then `CreateAdSet` (targeting/budget/optimization; `Targeting` is a JSON
object string), `CreateAdCreative` (`ObjectStorySpec` JSON string, or
`ObjectStoryId` to promote an existing page post), and `CreateAd` tying an
ad set to a creative (`Creative` = `{"creative_id":"..."}`).

`GetInsights` works on any level: pass an ad account (`act_...`),
campaign, ad set, or ad ID as `ObjectId`; use
`Breakdowns: connector.Ptr("publisher_platform")` to split Facebook vs
Instagram performance.

## Auth model

- Every request sends `Authorization: Bearer <AccessToken>`.
- Tokens are NOT auto-refreshed; use a long-lived or system-user token.
- New apps start in the Limited tier of the Marketing API Access Tier
  with stricter rate limits; limits also scale with ad-account spend.

## Errors

Non-2xx responses become `*connector.APIError`; `Code` is the Graph error
`code` (plus `/subcode`, e.g. `190` = invalid token, `100` = invalid
parameter, `17`/`80004` = rate limits), `Message` is Meta's message.

## Data conventions

- GET endpoints return only the fields you list in `Fields`.
- Budgets and bid amounts are in the account currency's minor units.
- Insight metrics come back as strings (Marketing API convention).
- Nested structures (`Targeting`, `PromotedObject`, `ObjectStorySpec`,
  `Filtering`, `TimeRange`, `Creative`) are raw JSON strings on requests.
- Pagination: pass `After` cursors from `Paging.Cursors`.

## Capability boundaries (what this connector does NOT do)

- No OAuth flow: obtaining tokens happens outside this SDK.
- No image/video uploads (adimages/advideos), custom audiences, pixels,
  catalogs, lead forms, or async insight jobs.
- No budget safety rails: create campaigns PAUSED and verify before
  activating.
- No retries by default; opt in with `connector.WithRetry`.

### Client options (all connectors)

`NewClient(cfg, opts...)` accepts shared options from the root
`connector` package:

- `connector.WithTimeout(d)` — overall per-call deadline (covers retries).
- `connector.WithRetry(connector.RetryPolicy{})` — opt-in automatic
  retries with exponential backoff honoring `Retry-After`. Defaults:
  3 attempts, statuses 429/502/503/504; non-idempotent methods (POST) are
  retried only on 429 unless `RetryNonIdempotent` is set.
- `connector.WithHTTPClient(hc)` — custom `*http.Client`.

### Error handling (all connectors)

Every non-2xx response is a `*connector.APIError` (StatusCode, service
Code/Message, raw Body, and the server's `RetryAfter` hint). Classify
without unwrapping via `connector.IsRateLimited(err)` (429),
`IsUnauthorized` (401), `IsForbidden` (403), `IsNotFound` (404),
`IsServerError` (5xx), `IsRetryable` (429/502/503/504), or use
`connector.AsAPIError(err)` / `connector.StatusCode(err)`.

Anything not listed here is outside this connector's capability boundary.
